ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% low-intensity (black) and 40% high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white regions are localized on the outer lobes with irregular, fractal-like boundaries meeting the central low-intensity black core. A distinct, dark elliptical spot is visible in the upper-distal region of the right lobe's white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex and an approximate angle of 35 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with prominent serration peaks. Left lobe contains approximately 4 distinct peaks; right lobe contains approximately 5 distinct peaks of varying pixel amplitude.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a concave sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp, upward-curving points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely clustered, roughly circular high-contrast tan and white pixel groups (barnacles) localized at both distal tips; the right tip cluster is significantly larger and more contiguous than the left.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically oriented linear pixel disruptions observed within the high-intensity white pigmentation of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle encrustations at both fluke tips; discrete dark focal spot on the white pigmentation of the right lobe distal area.
other_distinctive_markers: The combination of the specific dark spot on the right lobe and the unusually heavy, asymmetrical barnacle accumulation on the right distal tip.
